method: Warren/Wood/Vawter use separately constrained, midpoint-refined roof plans inset 0.3m and simplified 0.55m solely to smooth GIS digitization steps. Estimated height follows a convex power distance-to-roof-boundary profile normalized by sampled inradius, preserving sharper ridges. Structural shells remain on the exact GIS ring. FID66 retains its previous low roof form because its subgrade relationship is unresolved.
